info.name: CMMS API Tests
info.description: Integration test suite for CMMS Web API. Covers modules missing from the Excel UnitTest file: Plant AI, Contract, Payment, Expense, IoT, Sensor, Notification, Disease Report, Recommendation Task, Statistics, Weather, Maps. Run folders in order — `00_Auth` must run first to populate token variables.
